oven.en: Hmm. I'm going to say deep cleaning the oven because I really hate that job.
oven.zh: 嗯。我猜是深度清洁烤箱，因为我真的很讨厌那项工作。

oven.en: I thought it was cleaning the oven. Well, I'm afraid that's not the right answer.
oven.zh: 我以为是清洁烤箱。嗯，恐怕那不是正确的答案。

oven.en: I often think of everyone that I meet, but also myself through the context of like, I guess a similar analogy, like a set of ingredients that came together that were then put into an oven and like, the heat was turned on and we were bait not to say that we can't be changed after that moment but um what are those ingredients so my mother south african and hossa woman uh my father swiss from switzerland but was living in south africa so those are those are the parental ingredients you know my grandmother i think is a key ingredient because i spent a lot of time with her as a young child my grandfather was a crazy funny man was bipolar but we didn't know at the time i think we knew towards the end of his life but it made him wildly entertaining.
oven.zh: 我经常通过一种类比来审视我遇到的每一个人，也包括我自己，就像是一堆成分混合在一起，放进烤箱，加热，然后我们就出炉了——并不是说在那之后我们就不能改变了，但那些成分是什么呢？我母亲是南非科萨族女性，我父亲是瑞士人，但他当时住在南非，所以这些是父母给的成分。我觉得我祖母是一个关键成分，因为我小时候和她待在一起的时间很长。我祖父是个疯狂有趣的人，他患有躁郁症，但当时我们不知道，我想直到他生命末期我们才意识到，但这让他变得极其有娱乐性。

overwhelm.en: Overwhelm can lead to burnout, mental or physical exhaustion caused by working too hard.
overwhelm.zh: 不堪重负会导致精疲力竭，即工作过度导致的心理或身体极度疲劳。

overwhelm.en: He said he'd been overwhelmed and had created a parallel personality for himself.
overwhelm.zh: 他说自己当时不堪重负，为自己创造了一个平行人格。

overwhelm.en: After weeks of fighting, the defenders were overwhelmed, and Constantinople was captured.
overwhelm.zh: 经过数周的战斗，守军寡不敌众，君士坦丁堡被攻陷。

overwhelm.en: And overwhelm was also the topic of a recent BBC World Service programme, What in the World.
overwhelm.zh: 而“不堪重负”也是BBC世界服务近期节目《What in the World》的话题。

overwhelm.en: Big goals, massive targets, often fail because we feel overwhelmed.
overwhelm.zh: 宏大的目标和庞大的指标往往会失败，因为我们会感到不知所措。

overall.en: In terms of overall flourishing, which country do you think came out on top?
overall.zh: 就总体蓬勃发展而言，你认为哪个国家名列榜首？

overall.en: When you combine talent with advantage and especially skill, it makes up your overall ability.
overall.zh: 当你把天赋与优势、尤其是技能结合起来时，它就构成了你的整体能力。

overall.en: I’m not particularly good at reading. I’m trying to improve my overall level.
overall.zh: 我的阅读特别不在行。我正在努力提升我的整体水平。

overall.en: Um, so I think overall that there's going to be huge demand for these things.
overall.zh: 所以，我认为总体而言，对这些药物的需求将是巨大的。

overall.en: The focus is often on social security, work-life balance, having an overall good life.
overall.zh: 其重点往往在于社会保障、工作与生活的平衡以及整体上过上美好的生活。

overcome.en: You know, maybe overcoming something means that it now no longer negatively influences you.
overcome.zh: 你知道，也许克服某事意味着它现在不再对你产生负面影响了。

overcome.en: And I have to overcome that every day. That's what I'm saying.
overcome.zh: 我每天都必须克服这一点。这就是我想说的。

overcome.en: Now, poetry helped Maria overcome sadness, but could its power to heal work in other areas too?
overcome.zh: 现在，诗歌帮助玛丽亚克服了悲伤，但它的治愈力量也能在其他领域发挥作用吗？

overcome.en: I don't know. I don't think that we have like one fixed idea of overcoming something that isn't tangible.
overcome.zh: 我不知道。我不认为我们对‘克服’这种无形的东西有一个固定的概念。

overcome.en: Is that something that was a hurdle for you to overcome?
overcome.zh: 那是你需要克服的一个障碍吗？

overhead.en: Had a Soviet bomber flown overhead and dropped a bomb with such precision that it landed in the exact conference room where the Führer had been meeting?
overhead.zh: 难道是苏联轰炸机从头顶飞过，投下了一颗极其精准的炸弹，正好落在了元首开会的那个会议室里？

overhead.en: Yes, whether it's the rattle of train tracks, honking car horns, or the roar of aeroplanes overhead, modern cities are full of noise and this can have serious effects.
overhead.zh: 是的，无论是铁轨的咣当声、汽车的按喇叭声，还是头顶飞机轰鸣声，现代城市都充满了噪音，这会产生严重的影响。

overhead.en: He watched the forests around him being cut down by developers; he saw aircraft flying overhead, he heard the distant hum of industrial progress, and grew convinced that technology was spreading like a disease.
overhead.zh: 他看着身边的森林被开发商砍伐；他看到飞机从头顶飞过，听到远处工业进步的嗡嗡声，并坚信技术正像疾病一样蔓延。

overhead.en: I wonder whether there is a price that people who are more introspective, high integrity pay, because you think, well, you've got this heavier set of overheads that you need to pay in some way.
overhead.zh: 我想知道，那些更内省、正直的人是否需要付出某种代价，因为你会想，嗯，你有一套更沉重的日常开销，你需要以某种方式支付。

overseas.en: But this doesn’t mean that everyone in Overseas France is happy all the time.
overseas.zh: 但这并不意味着外海法国的每个人时时刻刻都很开心。

overseas.en: And also employers are much more cautious about sponsoring overseas graduates because it’s expensive.
overseas.zh: 而且雇主在赞助海外毕业生时也更加谨慎，因为这很昂贵。

overseas.en: It would govern them as part of its overseas empire for nearly ninety years.
overseas.zh: 作为其海外帝国的一部分，法国管辖了这些岛屿近九十年。

overseas.en: The biggest unknown issue for the future of Overseas France, though, is New Caledonia.
overseas.zh: 然而，海外法国未来最大的未知数是新喀里多尼亚。

overseas.en: The National Health Service in the UK still relies heavily on overseas staff.
overseas.zh: 英国的国家医疗服务体系（NHS）仍然严重依赖海外员工。

overload.en: It's just one of those overloaded words that means different things to different people.
overload.zh: 这只是那些对不同人意味着不同事物的重载词之一。

overload.en: So, you might feel overloaded, you might feel you can't cope, and that might be a temporary thing, hopefully.
overload.zh: 所以，你可能会感到超负荷，你可能会觉得自己无法应付，希望这只是一件暂时的的事。

overload.en: It's a different form of intelligence. It's not an intelligence again, And like love or like happiness is overloaded word that means many things to many people.
overload.zh: 这是一种不同形式的智能。它不是智能，再次，就像爱或幸福是过载的词，对许多人来说意味着许多事情。

overload.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.
overload.zh: 为了确保新客户不会使当地网络过载，排队等待的时间很长。在美国的某些地区，这些排队时间长达八年，如果你是一家竞相构建下一代人工智能的科技公司，八年时间实在太长了。

overthrow.en: And there was a revolution going on to overthrow the white supremacist government in Rhodesia.
overthrow.zh: 当时罗得西亚正爆发一场革命，要推翻白人至上主义政府。

overthrow.en: Is it: a) to overthrow, b) to over speak, or c) to overthink?
overthrow.zh: 是：a) 推翻，b) 说得过头，还是 c) 想得太多？

overthrow.en: And the British promised him exactly that, if he could overthrow the Ottomans, that was.
overthrow.zh: 英国人正是这样向他承诺的，前提是他能推翻奥斯曼人。

overthrow.en: A safe pair of hands, albeit not so different from those the people had just overthrown.
overthrow.zh: 一个稳妥可靠的人，尽管与人们刚刚推翻的那些人并没有太大区别。

overthrow.en: The Egyptians had done it – they had overthrown a man who had ruled their country for 30 years.
overthrow.zh: 埃及人做到了——他们推翻了一个统治了他们国家 30 年的人。

overestimate.en: A health halo refers to overestimating how healthy an item is based on a single feature, such as being low in calories, gluten-free or high in protein.
overestimate.zh: “健康光环（health halo）”指的是仅仅根据某一个特征（如低热量、无麸质或高蛋白）就高估某种食物有多健康。

overtime.en: When something has to work overtime, it works extra hard using lots of energy.
overtime.zh: 当某物必须超时工作时，它会消耗大量能量付出额外努力。

overtime.en: Work overtime also often means work longer than your set hours.
overtime.zh: 超时工作通常也意味着工作超过了你规定的时间。

overnight.en: It was an extraordinary move. Overnight, books, newspapers, and street signs had to be rewritten.
overnight.zh: 这是一个非凡的举措。一夜之间，书籍、报纸和路标都必须重新编写。

overnight.en: Evolution does not happen overnight. Species change slowly over long periods, across countless generations.
overnight.zh: 进化不是一夜之间发生的。物种在漫长的时间里、历经无数代缓慢地发生着变化。

overnight.en: Only if you steal so much as to become rich overnight, you will be caught.”
overnight.zh: “只有当你偷得太多以至于一夜暴富时，你才会被抓。”

overnight.en: But in the aftermath of the September 11th attacks in 2001, Blackwater’s business transformed almost overnight.
overnight.zh: 但在2001年“9·11”恐怖袭击之后，黑水公司的业务几乎在一夜之间转型。

overnight.en: Almost overnight, barbed wire fences appeared across the city.
overnight.zh: 几乎在一夜之间，带刺的铁丝网栅栏出现在城市各处。

overwhelming.en: But the PAP maintains an overwhelming amount of political power and dominance for decades.
overwhelming.zh: 但人民行动党在几十年来一直保持着压倒性的政治权力和统治地位。

overwhelming.en: But despite his overwhelming lead, the tournament quickly spiraled into a master class in self-sabotage.
overwhelming.zh: 但尽管遥遥领先，这场比赛却很快演变成了一堂关于自我毁灭的“大师课”。

overwhelming.en: And sure enough, the referendum was held in 1974, with an overwhelming majority voting for independence.
overwhelming.zh: 果不其然，公投于1974年举行，绝大多数人投票支持独立。

overwhelming.en: He felt overwhelming guilt and begged to return to the prison to prove he wasn’t a bad prisoner.
overwhelming.zh: 他感到无比愧疚，恳求回到监狱，证明自己不是个坏囚犯。

overwhelming.en: At first, it felt overwhelming, but almost immediately I realized that immersion was the fastest way to learn.
overwhelming.zh: 起初，这让人感觉有些招架不住，但几乎立刻，我就意识到沉浸式学习是掌握一门语言最快的方法。

overt.en: And it doesn't have to be that overt. You don't have to, the mind mud wrestling with itself is also a problem because I'd love to do that.
overt.zh: 而且这不必表现得那么明显。你不需要——大脑自己跟自己打架也是个问题，因为我其实很喜欢那样做。

overt.en: It was a clever idea because it would pin all blame on the SS and “treacherous forces within the Nazi party”, allowing for a relatively smooth transition to a Hitler-free Germany without all of the mess that might come from a more overt coup or assassination attempt.
overt.zh: 这是一个聪明的想法，因为它会将所有的责任归咎于党卫军和“纳粹党内的叛国势力”，从而相对顺利地过渡到一个没有希特勒的德国，而不会产生通过更公开的政变或暗杀企图可能带来的所有混乱。

oval.en: And then one day I went into the Oval Office and explained to the president that I just felt that I had no choice.
oval.zh: 然后有一天我走进椭圆形办公室，向总统解释说我只是觉得自己别无选择。

oval.en: Last month, the sitting Vice President Kamala Harris lost her bid to succeed Joe Biden and become the 16th person to transition from Vice President to the Oval Office.
oval.zh: 上个月，现任副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯竞选接替乔·拜登失败，未能成为第16位从副总统入主椭圆形办公室的人。

oval.en: Though they were originally supporting troops, many of them had been trained and equipped in the Roman style, with long spears, oval shields, and discipline drilled into them by years of warfare.
oval.zh: 虽然他们最初只是支援部队，但其中许多人已经接受了罗马风格的训练和装备，配备长矛、椭圆形盾牌，并且经过多年战事的洗礼，纪律严明。

overlook.en: Christ the Redeemer is an enormous statue of Jesus Christ overlooking the Brazilian city of Rio de Janeiro.
overlook.zh: 基督救世主雕像是一座俯瞰巴西里约热内卢市的巨大耶稣基督雕像。

overtake.en: For example, the difference between “overtaking a car “and “being overtaken by a car “.
overtake.zh: 例如，“超过一辆车”和“被一辆车超越”之间的区别。

overtake.en: For example, the difference between “overtaking a car “and “being overtaken by a car “.
overtake.zh: 例如，“超过一辆车”和“被一辆车超越”之间的区别。

overlap.en: We organize them slightly differently than ruler, but you can see the overlap very clearly.
overlap.zh: 我们组织这些维度的方式和 RULER 略有不同，但你能非常清楚地看出两者之间的重叠。

overlap.en: You immediately start comparing. And what you're doing there is you're sort of just trying to see if there's an overlap here.
overlap.zh: 你立刻开始比较。你在那里所做的，其实只是在试图看看是否有重叠。
